abstract: Incorporating greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions as an undesirable output of agricultural production in a directional distance function provides a better understanding of agricultural production performance. Based on balanced panel data from 126 prefecture‐level regions in the Yangtze River Basin in China, we employed a quadratic directional output‐oriented distance function to measure agricultural production performance in terms of environmental efficiency, relative shadow price of GHG emissions and Morishima elasticities of substitution between inputs. We found an upward trend, with average environmental efficiency of 0.871 during 2000–2020. This indicates that 12.9% more agricultural added value can be achieved, along with a 12.9% reduction in GHG emissions. Agricultural production in the upstream Yangtze River Basin region showed the best performance in terms of environmental efficiency. The estimated relative shadow price of GHG emissions was 4.606 and showed a negative association with environmental efficiency. Morishima elasticities of substitution indicated a substitution relationship of labour and fertiliser to land, and a strong complementary relationship between fertiliser and labour.
abstract_zh: 将温室气体排放作为农业生产非期望产出纳入方向性距离函数，有助于更深入理解农业生产绩效。基于中国长江流域126个地级市2000-2020年的平衡面板数据，采用二次型方向性产出距离函数，从环境效率、温室气体排放相对影子价格及投入要素间Morishima替代弹性三个维度测度农业生产绩效。研究发现：样本期间平均环境效率为0.871且呈上升趋势，表明在实现12.9%农业增加值增长的同时可同步减少12.9%的温室气体排放；长江上游地区农业生产的环境效率表现最优；温室气体排放相对影子价格估计值为4.606，且与环境效率呈负相关关系；Morishima替代弹性显示劳动力和化肥对土地存在替代关系，而化肥与劳动力之间呈现强互补关系。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Synergies or Trade‐Offs Between Environmental and Economic Outcomes? An Analysis of Agricultural Production Performance
title_zh: 环境与经济成果之间的协同还是权衡？农业生产绩效分析

abstract: This study investigates how distance learning during COVID-19 affected educational outcomes of lower secondary students in Sweden. In contrast to most previously studied contexts characterized by prolonged and fully remote school closures, Sweden represents a school system with a high level of digital preparedness, in which distance learning was implemented for a limited period, often combined with in-person instruction, and accompanied by exemptions for students with special needs. Using a difference-in-differences design with entropy balancing, we compare pre-pandemic and pandemic-affected cohorts. Our findings suggest that students in schools that adopted remote instruction performed similarly on standardized tests to those in schools that maintained in-person teaching throughout the pandemic. Moreover, progression to upper secondary school was not negatively affected. In some cases, we even find positive effects of remote instruction.
title: Just the right amount of caution? Remote instruction and student performance in Sweden during the COVID-19 pandemic
title_zh: 恰到好处的谨慎？新冠疫情期间瑞典的远程教学与学生表现

abstract: We investigate the impact of the controversial 2022 amendment to Rule 10b5-1, which imposed a cooling-off period and restricted overlapping and single-trade plans on prearranged insider transactions. Our evidence is consistent with the amendment leading insiders to (i) execute stock sales under 10b5-1 plans with longer cooling-off periods; (ii) curtail opportunistic sales under 10b5-1 plans prior to stock price drops or earnings misses; (iii) limit the backdating of stock gifts; and (iv) decrease the granting of options around material information events. Further evidence suggests a reduction in opportunistic 10b5-1 trades rather than a migration toward non-10b5-1 sales. We find mixed evidence on the amendment's effect on price efficiency. Finally, terminations of 10b5-1 plans are associated with positive subsequent stock returns, suggesting that insiders avoid selling when they expect favorable news. Overall, our findings indicate that the amendment substantially curtailed the opportunistic use of 10b5-1 plans, its primary objective.
title: Insider trading after the 2022 Rule 10b5-1 amendment
title_zh: 2022年规则10b5-1修订后的内幕交易

abstract: Platform industries have seen a growing wave of mergers and acquisitions in recent times. In this short paper, we investigate ex-post strategies of the monopoly platform business and its impact on user welfare. We develop a model of a duopoly market of E-commerce platforms where a merger is under consideration. This paper analyzes two possible post-merger strategies; a two-platform monopoly and a single-platform monopoly. Our findings suggest that (i) users are better off with a single-platform monopoly when both buyers and sellers singlehome; (ii) when one of the user groups multihomes and the other group singlehomes, a two-platform monopoly can result in a higher user surplus compared to single-platform monopoly if the platforms are highly differentiated. Our results provide useful guidance to policymakers on post-merger strategies of E-commerce platforms.
abstract_zh: 近年来，平台产业并购浪潮日益高涨。本文旨在探讨垄断平台企业的事后策略及其对用户福利的影响。我们构建了一个考虑并购的电子商务平台双头垄断市场模型，并分析了两种可能的事后并购策略：双平台垄断与单平台垄断。研究发现：（i）当买卖双方均选择单一归属时，单平台垄断对用户更为有利；（ii）当一方用户群体多归属而另一方单一归属时，若平台间差异化程度较高，双平台垄断相比单平台垄断能带来更高的用户剩余。我们的研究结果为政策制定者提供了关于电子商务平台并购后策略的有益指导。
title: Horizontal mergers in E-commerce platforms: Ex-post strategies and user welfare
title_zh: 电子商务平台横向合并：事后策略与用户福利

abstract: Does central bank independence shape the inflationary impact of geopolitical risk? Using a panel of 29 countries over 1990–2023, we show that geopolitical risk significantly increases inflation, but that this effect depends on the degree of central bank independence. Higher institutional credibility substantially attenuates, and in some case offsets, the inflationary impact of geopolitical shocks. This moderating effect is stronger for geopolitical threats than for realized actions and is considerably more pronounced in advanced than in emerging economies. These findings highlight the importance of credible monetary institutions in enhancing resilience to geopolitical inflation.
abstract_zh: 中央银行独立性是否影响地缘政治风险的通胀效应？基于1990-2023年29个国家的面板数据，我们发现地缘政治风险显著推高通胀水平，但该效应取决于中央银行的独立程度。更高的制度可信度能显著削弱——在某些情况下甚至抵消——地缘政治冲击的通胀影响。相较于已发生的实际行动，这种调节效应对地缘政治威胁更为显著，且在发达经济体中的表现远强于新兴经济体。这些发现凸显了可信货币制度在增强抵御地缘政治通胀韧性方面的重要作用。
title: Geopolitical risk and inflation: Does central bank independence matter?
title_zh: 地缘政治风险与通货膨胀：央行独立性是否重要？

abstract: This paper investigates the distinct effects of oil-specific and global uncertainty shocks on the stock returns of international oil and gas companies. Using monthly data from May 2007 to August 2025, we employ a Dynamic Factor Model on high-frequency volatility indices to construct separate proxies for global uncertainty and idiosyncratic oil uncertainty shocks. The dynamic effects of these shocks are estimated using Smoothed Local Projections. Global uncertainty shocks generate an immediate and homogeneous decline in stock returns across integrated, upstream, and downstream firms. In contrast, the effects of oil-specific uncertainty depend on a firm’s position within the value chain. Upstream firms exhibit the most pronounced responses, integrated firms display intermediate and mixed effects, while downstream companies appear comparatively insulated from oil-market uncertainty. These findings highlight the importance of distinguishing global from sector-specific uncertainty when assessing the financial consequences of uncertainty shocks in energy markets.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了石油特定冲击与全球不确定性冲击对国际油气公司股票收益的差异化影响。利用2007年5月至2025年8月的月度数据，我们采用动态因子模型对高频波动率指数进行分析，构建了全球不确定性与特质性石油不确定性冲击的独立代理变量。通过平滑局部投影法估计这些冲击的动态效应。全球不确定性冲击导致综合、上游及下游企业的股票收益立即且同质性地下降。相比之下，石油特定不确定性的影响则取决于企业在价值链中的位置。上游企业表现出最显著的反应，综合企业呈现中间且混合的效果，而下游公司则相对免受石油市场不确定性的影响。这些发现强调了在评估能源市场不确定性冲击的财务后果时，区分全球性与部门特定不确定性的重要性。
title: Effects of oil price uncertainty on the stock returns of oil and gas companies
title_zh: 油价不确定性对油气公司股票收益的影响

abstract: We consider tests for normality, residual autocorrelation, and autoregressive conditional heteroskedasticity for a time series regression, which includes various zero-one dummy variables for individual observations. The sizes of these tests are distorted as the residuals associated with the dummies are equal to zero. We propose a simple solution which amounts to dismissing the observations with these zero-valued residuals, that is, treat these observations as missing. With simulations we show that the resulting tests have the proper size.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑时间序列回归中的正态性检验、残差自相关检验以及自回归条件异方差检验，该回归包含针对个体观测值的各种0-1虚拟变量。由于与虚拟变量相关的残差为零，这些检验的显著性水平存在扭曲。我们提出一个简单解决方案，即剔除这些残差为零的观测值，将其视为缺失值处理。通过模拟研究，我们证明修正后的检验具有恰当的显著性水平。
title: Diagnostic testing a time series regression with zero-one dummies
title_zh: 零一虚拟变量时间序列回归的诊断检验

abstract: I develop a unified model of resource and risk sharing in which 𝑁 agents pool against a common crisis threshold subject to transaction costs. Three results follow. As transaction costs fall: the welfare-optimal pool expands and individual buffers shrink; average welfare improves strictly; and expected crisis scale — the number of agents simultaneously unable to access the shared resource — grows, even if crisis probability falls. The mechanism is identical across financial risk pooling, supply-chain management, and transportation networks. Large systemic crises are the necessary consequence of welfare-optimal pooling. The correct policy response is a Pigouvian charge on each participant’s marginal contribution to expected crisis scale.
abstract_zh: 我构建了一个统一的资源与风险分担模型，其中N个代理在面临交易成本的情况下，共同应对一个共同的危机阈值。由此得出三个结论。随着交易成本的降低：福利最优的池子规模扩大，个体缓冲减少；平均福利严格改善；以及预期危机规模——即同时无法获取共享资源的代理数量——增大，即使危机概率下降。这一机制在金融风险分担、供应链管理和交通网络中均相同。大规模系统性危机是福利最优分担的必要结果。正确的政策应对是对每个参与者对预期危机规模的边际贡献征收庇古税。
title: Why efficient systems fail spectacularly: A unified theory of systemic risk
title_zh: 高效系统为何惨败：系统性风险的统一理论

abstract: This paper examines whether industrial land bias in China’s land-supply policy crowds out social public services. Using prefecture-level panel data spanning 2002–2022, we construct an Industrial Land Bias Index (ILBI) and a City Public Service Index (CPSI) to analyze the relationship between growth-oriented land allocation and public service composition. We document a robust structural crowding-out effect: a one-standard-deviation increase in industrial land bias corresponds to a 0.32 %age-point decline in the share of social services (education, healthcare, social security and welfare, and culture and sports) within total public service capacity. Decomposition analysis reveals that this effect operates primarily through price concessions rather than quantity allocation. The crowding-out relationship is stronger in more market-oriented land-transfer environments, consistent with price discounts providing clearer signals of pro-industry commitment. The effect is most pronounced among cities with high fiscal self-sufficiency and among those with more service-oriented economies. These findings expose hidden opportunity costs of China’s “land-for-growth” model and offer policy implications for rebalancing urban public service provision.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国土地供应政策中的工业用地偏向是否挤出了社会公共服务。利用2002—2022年地级市面板数据，我们构建了工业用地偏向指数（ILBI）与城市公共服务指数（CPSI），以分析增长导向的土地配置与公共服务结构之间的关系。我们发现了稳健的结构性挤出效应：工业用地偏向每增加一个标准差，社会服务（教育、医疗卫生、社会保障与福利、文化体育）在公共服务总能力中的占比将下降0.32个百分点。分解分析表明，该效应主要通过价格让渡而非数量配置发挥作用。在市场化程度更高的土地出让环境中，挤出关系更为显著，这与价格折扣为亲工业承诺提供更清晰信号的事实相一致。该效应在财政自给率较高的城市以及服务业导向更强的城市中最为突出。这些发现揭示了“以地谋增长”模式中隐含的机会成本，并为重新平衡城市公共服务供给提供了政策启示。

title: Does industrial land bias crowd out social public services? Evidence from China
title_zh: 工业用地偏向是否挤出了社会公共服务？来自中国的证据

abstract: The lack of urban planning in Latin America’s medium-sized cities, especially in the Caribbean, has resulted in uncontrolled expansion with severe implications in the context of climate emergencies. This expansion manifests through two intertwined processes: “urban sprawl,” understood as outward, land‑consuming (often low‑density) growth, and “informal settlements,” referring to residential areas developed outside formal planning, regulatory, or tenure frameworks. Although analytically distinct, both dynamics frequently overlap in intermediate Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC), where peripheral growth is predominantly driven by informal urbanisation. These cities/urban peripheries are highly vulnerable and urgently need to integrate the climate dimension into their urban development strategies. This paper analyses the scientific and grey literature published between 2014 and 2024 on urban sprawl in medium-sized cities to identify the extent to which literature incorporates the challenges of climate change. Artificial intelligence techniques were applied when searching and reviewing academic and technical sources. The results show that scientific literature is oriented towards explanation and modelling (Geographic Information Systems (GIS), simulation, artificial intelligence), while the grey literature emphasises implementation and monitoring. Both converge in the use of GIS and complement each other: the scientific production provides diagnosis and analysis; the technical, action and applicability. This division of roles, however, creates a functional asynchrony: peer-reviewed scientific production typically operates on medium- to long-term research and publication timelines, whereas technical documentation responds to shorter decision windows and implementation deadlines. This temporal misalignment, in turn, highlights the need to reinforce implementation-oriented instruments for climate adaptation (especially in highly exposed Caribbean intermediate cities) so that rapid decision-making can more effectively draw upon and operationalise scientific evidence.
abstract_zh: 拉丁美洲中等城市，尤其是加勒比地区，因缺乏城市规划导致无序扩张，在气候紧急背景下产生严重后果。这种扩张通过两个相互交织的过程显现：“城市蔓延”——即向外、消耗土地（通常为低密度）的增长，以及“非正规住区”——指在正式规划、监管或产权框架之外开发的居住区。尽管分析上有所区分，但这两种动态在拉丁美洲和加勒比（LAC）的中等城市中频繁重叠，其边缘增长主要由非正规城市化驱动。这些城市/城市边缘区高度脆弱，亟需将气候维度纳入城市发展战略。本文分析了2014年至2024年间关于中等城市城市蔓延的科学文献与灰色文献，以识别文献在多大程度上纳入了气候变化挑战。在检索和审阅学术与技术资料时应用了人工智能技术。结果表明，科学文献侧重于解释与建模（地理信息系统（GIS）、模拟、人工智能），而灰色文献强调实施与监测。两者在GIS应用上趋于一致且相互补充：科学产出提供诊断与分析，技术产出提供行动与可操作性。然而，这种角色分工造成了功能上的异步性：同行评审的科学产出通常遵循中长期研究与发表周期，而技术文档则响应较短的决策窗口与实施期限。这种时间错位进而凸显了加强面向气候适应的实施导向工具（尤其在高度暴露的加勒比中等城市）的必要性，以便快速决策能更有效地借鉴并运用科学证据。
title: Urban expansion, informality and climate change in intermediate cities in Latin America and the Caribbean: Challenges and opportunities
title_zh: 拉丁美洲和加勒比地区中等城市的城市扩张、非正规性与气候变化：挑战与机遇

abstract: Using Measure 114’s narrow passage in Oregon as a natural experiment, we study how new gun regulations affect firearm demand. Background checks, a proxy for demand, rose 13.9% in anticipation of the referendum and surged 157% immediately following the election. After judicial intervention halted the law’s enactment, demand returned near pre-election levels. Temporal displacement/harvesting does not explain the demand spike: after eighteen months, we still observe a substantial cumulative increase of 63,000 excess firearm-related background checks. Administrative data reveal significant within-state heterogeneity. This evidence underscores the paradoxical effect of gun-control policies, offering a cautionary lesson to policymakers.
abstract_zh: 以俄勒冈州第114号法案的微弱通过作为自然实验，我们研究了新枪支管制法规如何影响枪支需求。作为需求代理指标的背景调查，在公投预期阶段上升了13.9%，选举结束后立即激增157%。司法干预暂停该法律实施后，需求回落至接近选举前水平。时间转移/收割效应无法解释需求激增现象：十八个月后，我们仍观察到累计增加6.3万次超额枪支相关背景调查的显著效应。行政数据揭示了显著的州内异质性。这些证据凸显了枪支管制政策的悖论效应，为政策制定者提供了警示性启示。
title: Gun policy and the steel paradox
title_zh: 枪支政策与钢铁悖论

abstract: Investors’ return expectations are pivotal in stock markets, but the reasoning behind these expectations is not well understood. This paper explores economic agents’ mental models of what drives returns. We survey the general population, retail investors, financial professionals, and academic experts to investigate how they forecast and explain future returns in scenarios with stale news about future company earnings. We find that investors strongly disagree in their forecasts and reasoning. Most academic experts view markets as efficient. By contrast, most households express a perspective we call “expected earnings reasoning”: they directly equate higher expected earnings with higher expected returns. Professionals are split between market efficiency, mispricing, and expected earnings reasoning. In detailed experiments, we dissect why households adopt expected earnings reasoning. We show that it arises from inattention to how stock-price changes affect investor costs — that is, how much investors must pay to acquire a claim to future cash flows — because the typical format and context of investment problems obscure these cost implications. Our results help connect a series of previously documented anomalies in expectation and trading data and highlight the importance of selective attention and context in shaping reasoning and belief formation.
abstract_zh: 投资者的回报预期在股票市场中至关重要，但这些预期背后的推理机制尚不明确。本文探究经济主体对驱动回报因素的心智模型。我们通过调查普通民众、散户投资者、金融专业人士及学术专家，研究他们在面对未来公司盈利的陈旧信息时，如何预测和解释未来回报。研究发现，投资者在预测和推理上存在显著分歧。大多数学术专家认为市场是有效的。相比之下，多数家庭持有一种我们称之为"预期盈利推理"的观点：他们直接将更高的预期盈利等同于更高的预期回报。专业人士则分为市场有效派、错误定价派和预期盈利推理派。通过精细实验，我们剖析了家庭为何采用预期盈利推理。研究表明，这种推理源于投资者对股价变动如何影响投资成本——即投资者为获取未来现金流索取权所需支付的对价——的忽视，因为投资问题的典型呈现形式和背景掩盖了这些成本含义。我们的研究结果有助于串联此前在预期和交易数据中记录的一系列异常现象，并凸显选择性注意和背景在塑造推理与信念形成中的关键作用。
title: Mental Models of the Stock Market
title_zh: 股票市场的心理模型

abstract: Information often spreads and influences beliefs regardless of its reliability. We show that this occurs in part because indicators of reliability tend to be lost in the process of word-of-mouth transmission. We conduct controlled experiments where participants listen to economic forecasts and pass them on through voice messages. Other participants listen either to original or transmitted audio recordings and report incentivized beliefs. Across various transmitter incentive schemes, a claim’s reliability is lost in transmission much more than the claim itself. Reliable and unreliable information, once filtered through transmission, impact listener beliefs similarly. Mechanism experiments show that reliability is lost not because it is perceived as less relevant or harder to transmit, but because it is less likely to come to mind during transmission. Evidence from our experiments, a large corpus of everyday conversations, and economic TV news shows that contextual cues can bring reliability to mind and induce its transmission, but situations in which people share information seldom contain such cues.
abstract_zh: 信息往往在传播过程中影响人们的信念，无论其可靠性如何。我们证明，这种现象部分源于口碑传播过程中可靠性指标容易丢失。我们开展控制实验，让参与者听取经济预测并通过语音信息传递。其他参与者听取原始或转述的录音，并报告受激励的信念。在不同传递者激励方案下，信息的可靠性在传播中的损失程度远高于信息本身。可靠与不可靠的信息经过传播过滤后，对听众信念的影响趋于一致。机制实验表明，可靠性丢失并非因其被认为相关性较低或更难传递，而是因为在传播过程中更不易被想起。来自我们的实验、大规模日常对话语料库以及经济类电视新闻的证据显示，情境线索能够唤起对可靠性的关注并促使其传播，但人们分享信息的情境中很少包含此类线索。
title: The Transmission of Reliable and Unreliable Information
title_zh: 可靠与不可靠信息的传播

abstract: This study examines how young adults respond to local labor market disruptions caused by military base closures in Sweden between 1998 and 2005. The results show substantial differences in responses between men and women, reflecting the sharp gender imbalance in military roles. Affected men increase enrollment in tertiary education, particularly when living in proximity to higher education institutions. In contrast, women experience improved labor market outcomes a few years after a closure, with higher earnings and employment rates. This suggests that the structural transformation of the local labor market, following the exit of a major male‐dominated employer, benefits young women as they transition into employment in expanding sectors.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了1998年至2005年间瑞典军事基地关闭所引发的当地劳动力市场冲击对年轻人的影响。结果显示，男性和女性在应对方式上存在显著差异，这反映了军事岗位中严重的性别失衡。受影响的男性更倾向于接受高等教育，尤其是当他们居住在高等教育机构附近时。相比之下，女性在基地关闭数年后劳动力市场状况有所改善，表现为收入提高和就业率上升。这表明，随着以男性为主导的大型雇主退出，当地劳动力市场的结构性转型使年轻女性受益，她们得以进入扩张中的行业就业。
title: Effects of military base closures on young adults
title_zh: 军事基地关闭对年轻人的影响

abstract: Urban streets increasingly serve as contested arenas where formal and informal economic activities intersect, generating visible and persistent conflicts. Informal work—such as street vending, mobile services, and temporary labor—directly challenges urban managers, especially in regulating land use, governing public spaces, and shaping economic policies. Although scholars have explored various aspects of these tensions, researchers still lack a comprehensive and systematic understanding of how cities across the world have responded through policy. This study systematically reviews academic and policy literature published between 1980 and 2025 to map the full range of urban policy responses to conflicts between formal and informal work. Based on predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria, the study analyzes 297 peer-reviewed articles and policy reports to identify response patterns, regional trends, and conceptual frameworks. It classifies responses into three main types: exclusionary (e.g., evictions and policing), accommodative (e.g., licensing and designated zones), and integrative (e.g., participatory planning and hybrid governance). The findings reveal that although many cities still rely on exclusionary approaches, more inclusive and negotiated strategies increasingly shape urban responses—especially in cities of the Global South. This review offers a clearer understanding of the evolving landscape of urban policy responses and lays the groundwork for more equitable, adaptive, and context-sensitive urban governance.
abstract_zh: 城市街道日益成为正式与非正式经济活动交汇的竞争性场域，由此产生显著且持续的冲突。非正式工作——如街头贩卖、流动服务和临时劳动——直接挑战着城市管理者，尤其是在土地利用规制、公共空间治理和经济政策制定方面。尽管学者们已从多个维度探讨了这些紧张关系，但研究者仍缺乏对全球各城市如何通过政策加以回应的全面而系统的理解。本研究系统梳理了1980年至2025年间发表的学术与政策文献，以描绘城市对正式与非正式工作冲突的政策回应的完整图谱。基于预设的纳入与排除标准，本研究分析了297篇同行评审文章和政策报告，以识别回应模式、区域趋势及概念框架。研究将回应划分为三种主要类型：排斥性（如驱逐和警务执法）、包容性（如许可制度和指定区域）以及整合性（如参与式规划和混合治理）。研究发现，尽管许多城市仍依赖排斥性策略，但更具包容性和协商性的策略正日益塑造城市回应——尤其是在全球南方城市中。本综述为理解城市政策回应的演变格局提供了更清晰的视角，并为更公平、更具适应性和情境敏感性的城市治理奠定了基础。
title: When streets collide: Urban policy responses to informal–formal work conflicts
title_zh: 当街道碰撞：非正规与正规工作冲突的城市政策应对

abstract: Using text-as-data methods, we quantify the U.S. discourse on China, place it in historical perspective, and compare its evolution across different sources of public narrative. Our analysis is based on a large corpus of materials drawn from public records (presidential and congressional records, newspaper articles, social media, think tank reports). We develop two measures of narrative discourse: an indicator of the frequency with which China is covered and a proxy for how positively or negatively China is presented. We document a sustained decline in net sentiment towards China in presidential sources since the early 2000s, predating Donald Trump’s first term in office. In contrast to presidential documents, congressional, news media, social media, and think tank sources exhibit persistent negative sentiment towards China even in decades prior to the 2000s. Instead of a deterioration in sentiment across the board, what we find is a convergence in presidential sentiment to other sources of narrative discourse. We find no evidence that presidential leadership has played a significant role in setting the narrative tone for the nation as a whole. Historical and shorter-term evidence both point to a bottom-up process of diffusion of narratives, rather than top-down diffusion.
abstract_zh: 采用文本数据方法，我们量化了美国涉华话语体系，将其置于历史视角下审视，并比较了不同公共叙事来源的演变过程。分析基于涵盖公共记录（总统与国会档案、报刊文章、社交媒体、智库报告）的大型语料库。我们构建了叙事话语的两项指标：中国话题的报道频率指数，以及中国形象呈现的正面/负面倾向代理变量。研究发现，自21世纪初以来，总统文献中对华净情感指数持续走低，这一趋势早于唐纳德·特朗普的首个任期。与总统文献形成对比的是，国会、新闻媒体、社交媒体及智库来源在21世纪前的数十年间已持续呈现对华负面倾向。我们观察到的并非全面情感恶化，而是总统话语与其他叙事来源的趋同现象。未发现总统领导力在塑造全国叙事基调中发挥显著作用的证据。历史与短期证据均指向叙事传播的自下而上模式，而非自上而下扩散。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: The China Backlash: Quantifying the Narrative Discourse on China
title_zh: 中国反弹：量化关于中国的叙事话语

abstract: This study investigates the decline in Bureau of Land Management (BLM) grazing allotments, authorized Animal Unit Months, across eight Intermountain states (Arizona, Colorado, Idaho, Montana, Nevada, New Mexico, Utah, Wyoming) from 1980 to 2022, examining the role of drought and structural change. Using outlier detection and structural break tests, we identify a concentrated regime shift in the early 2000s, with seven of eight states experiencing a statistically significant break between 2000 and 2003. Post‐break allotments declined by 11% regionally, ranging from 8% in New Mexico to 27% in Colorado. Outlier analysis reveals substantial heterogeneity in the nature of shocks, with Idaho and Utah experiencing permanent level shifts, Colorado a temporary change, and Wyoming multiple shocks of all types. To quantify drought impacts, we estimate a fixed effects model with a lagged dependent variable and a state‐specific structural break dummy. Results show that a one‐unit decrease in the Palmer Drought Severity Index (PDSI) reduces allotments by 0.5% immediately and by 3.6% in the long run under sustained drought. The break dummy is negative and highly significant, indicating a permanent 6.5% reduction in allotments following the early 2000s drought that is not explained by drought or market variables alone. This suggests that factors beyond drought have reduced grazing capacity. A sustained severe drought (three‐unit PDSI decrease) would permanently remove approximately 893,000 Animal Unit Months (AUMs) annually from the region, equivalent to 149,000–179,000 cow‐calf pairs and representing between $9 million and $27 million in lost forage value at private lease rates. These findings support reforms to drought relief programs to account for lagged and permanent effects, flexible permitting mechanisms for temporary drought, and long‐term adjustment assistance for permanent reductions. State‐specific heterogeneity in drought impacts implies that, while BLM already administers grazing at state and district levels, further differentiation of drought relief and permit flexibility based on state‐level vulnerabilities may improve effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 本研究调查了1980年至2022年间美国土地管理局（BLM）在八个山地州（亚利桑那州、科罗拉多州、爱达荷州、蒙大拿州、内华达州、新墨西哥州、犹他州、怀俄明州）放牧配额（授权动物单位月）的下降趋势，并考察了干旱与结构性变化的作用。通过异常值检测与结构性断点检验，我们识别出21世纪初存在集中的制度变迁：八个州中有七个在2000年至2003年间出现统计显著的断点。断点后区域放牧配额平均下降11%，各州降幅从新墨西哥州的8%到科罗拉多州的27%不等。异常值分析揭示了冲击性质的显著异质性：爱达荷州与犹他州经历永久性水平位移，科罗拉多州为暂时性变化，而怀俄明州则遭遇多种类型的多重冲击。为量化干旱影响，我们构建了包含滞后因变量与州特定结构性断点虚拟变量的固定效应模型。结果显示：帕尔默干旱指数（PDSI）每下降1个单位，放牧配额在短期内立即减少0.5%，在持续干旱条件下长期累计减少3.6%。断点虚拟变量为负且高度显著，表明21世纪初干旱后放牧配额永久性减少6.5%，这一降幅无法仅由干旱或市场变量解释，暗示干旱以外的因素削弱了放牧承载力。持续严重干旱（PDSI下降3个单位）将导致该区域每年永久性减少约89.3万动物单位月（AUMs），相当于14.9万至17.9万对母牛-牛犊组合，按私人租赁费率计算，牧草价值损失达900万至2700万美元。这些发现支持对干旱救济计划进行改革，以纳入滞后与永久性效应、建立临时干旱的灵活许可机制，并为永久性减少提供长期调整援助。干旱影响的州际异质性表明，尽管BLM已在州与地区层面实施放牧管理，但基于州级脆弱性进一步差异化干旱救济与许可灵活性，可能提升政策有效性。
title: Drought, Structural Breaks, and the Economics of Public Land Grazing: Evidence From the Intermountain West
title_zh: 干旱、结构性突变与公共土地放牧经济学：来自美国西部山间地区的证据

abstract: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA) strengthens the agricultural risk coverage (ARC) and price loss coverage (PLC) programs by aligning program parameters more closely with recent market dynamics and allows for an expansion in program acres. This study projects the increases in ARC‐County and PLC payments for corn, soybeans, and wheat under OBBBA, compared with those under the 2018 Farm Bill. Total projected program payments would increase by $4.65 billion for crop year 2025 and $1.30–$2.13 billion for crop year 2026 (depending on the relative enrollment rates), with high regional heterogeneity. JEL Classification: Q14, Q18
abstract_zh: 《一项宏大美丽法案》（OBBBA）通过使项目参数更贴近近期市场动态，强化了农业风险覆盖（ARC）和价格损失覆盖（PLC）项目，并允许扩大项目面积。本研究预测了在OBBBA下，相较于2018年农业法案，玉米、大豆和小麦的ARC-县及PLC支付额的增长情况。预计2025作物年项目总支付额将增加46.5亿美元，2026作物年将增加13亿至21.3亿美元（具体取决于相对参保率），且存在显著的区域异质性。JEL分类：Q14, Q18
title: Expanded Farm Safety Net Payments Under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act
title_zh: 《大美丽法案》下扩大农业安全网支付

abstract: This paper examines the causal impact of agronomic technology adoption, induced by technical assistance programmes, on factor misallocation and aggregate agricultural productivity. While the literature has established the central role of land and capital market imperfections as sources of misallocation in agriculture, the potential of technological adoption to correct these inefficiencies has received limited attention. This paper directly addresses this gap by combining a calibrated equilibrium model with causal inference methods, using Chile as a case study. The results show that, among farmers whose adoption is induced by access to technical assistance programmes, factor misallocation is reduced by approximately 22 percentage points. This effect is robust across alternative efficiency measures, functional specifications and parametric assumptions, and remains stable after purging idiosyncratic productivity from agroclimatic conditions such as rainfall and soil quality. Technological adoption significantly increases participation in land rental markets and access to bank credit, thereby facilitating the reallocation of resources towards more productive farmers. In addition, the analysis identifies local spillover effects: farmers in municipalities with higher adoption rates exhibit lower misallocation. Counterfactual exercises further indicate that these effects are amplified when frictions in land markets are reduced.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了由技术援助项目引致的农艺技术采纳对要素错配和农业总生产率的影响。尽管已有文献确立了土地和资本市场不完善是农业错配的主要根源，但技术采纳在纠正这些效率损失方面的潜力却鲜受关注。本文通过将校准均衡模型与因果推断方法相结合，以智利为案例研究，直接填补了这一空白。结果表明，在因获得技术援助项目而采纳技术的农户中，要素错配降低了约22个百分点。这一效应在替代效率测度、函数设定和参数假设下均保持稳健，且在剔除降雨和土壤质量等农业气候条件带来的异质性生产率后依然稳定。技术采纳显著提高了农户参与土地租赁市场和获得银行信贷的机会，从而促进了资源向更具生产率的农户重新配置。此外，分析还识别出局部溢出效应：在技术采纳率较高的市镇，农户的错配程度较低。反事实分析进一步表明，当土地市场摩擦减少时，这些效应会得到放大。
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Beyond Productivity: Technology Adoption and Factor Allocation in Agriculture
title_zh: 超越生产力：农业中的技术采纳与要素配置

abstract: The agricultural sector's share of GDP in growing economies typically declines but, for a century from the early 1850s, Australia's did not. That trend is most evident for the former colony and now State of South Australia (SA). Moreover, that share for SA has been almost flat since 1980 as well, along with the agricultural sector's share of SA exports. This paper seeks to shed light on the forces behind the unusual evolution of these sectoral shares for SA both up to 1950 and since 1980. The extensive time series data compiled for this paper suggest various partial explanations. For 1850–1950, they include the huge arable land area per worker, clearly defined and enforced property rights in settled rural areas as the frontier of European settlement expanded, the absence of a need to do any processing of the main 19th century exports (copper, wool and wheat), a strong public agricultural research and extension system, and the absence of major mining booms after the copper finds in the 1840s and 1860s.
abstract_zh: 在经济增长过程中，农业部门占GDP的比重通常会下降，但从19世纪50年代初开始的一个世纪里，澳大利亚的这一比重并未下降。这一趋势在前殖民地、现南澳大利亚州（SA）表现得最为明显。此外，自1980年以来，南澳大利亚州农业部门占GDP的比重以及农业部门占该州出口的比重几乎保持平稳。本文旨在揭示南澳大利亚州在1950年之前及1980年之后这些部门份额异常演变的驱动因素。本文编制的大量时间序列数据提供了多种局部解释。对于1850年至1950年期间，这些因素包括：人均可耕地面积巨大；随着欧洲定居前沿的扩展，定居农村地区明确界定并有效执行的产权；19世纪主要出口产品（铜、羊毛和小麦）无需任何加工；强大的公共农业研究与推广体系；以及19世纪40年代和60年代铜矿发现后未出现重大矿业繁荣。
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Forces Behind South Australia's Unusual Structural Changes Since 1840
title_zh: 1840年以来南澳大利亚州异常结构变化背后的驱动力

abstract: This paper studies a new axiom of choice functions, equal treatment of individuals in an indifference class (ETI), in the context of matching problems. We show that when a choice function satisfies ETI, substitutability, and size monotonicity, any individual for whom equal treatment applies must be either always accepted whenever available or never accepted. The set of admissible choice functions expands substantially when any one of these three axioms is dropped. ETI is also incompatible with 𝑞 -acceptance. We characterize the minimum degree of 𝑞 -acceptance violation under ETI, substitutability, and either size monotonicity or consistency. Under size monotonicity, the minimum is characterized by a partition of indifference classes into two groups. By contrast, under consistency, it is characterized by the size of a particular indifference class.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了选择函数的一个新公理——无差异类中个体平等待遇（ETI），并将其置于匹配问题的背景下。我们证明，当选择函数满足ETI、可替代性和规模单调性时，任何适用平等待遇的个体，要么在可用时总被接受，要么永不被接受。若这三条公理中任意一条被舍弃，可容许选择函数的集合将大幅扩展。ETI还与𝑞-接受性不相容。我们刻画了在ETI、可替代性以及规模单调性或一致性条件下，𝑞-接受性违反的最小程度。在规模单调性下，最小值由无差异类划分为两组来表征；相比之下，在一致性下，则通过特定无差异类的大小来表征。
title: Equal treatment and its market design implications
title_zh: 平等待遇及其市场设计含义

abstract: Auctions with endogenous rationing have been introduced to stimulate competition. Such (procurement) auctions reduce the volume put out to tender when competition is low. This paper finds a strong negative effect of endogenous rationing on participation when bid-preparation is costly, counteracting the aim to stimulate competition. For multiple auctioneer's objectives mentioned in directives, we derive optimal mechanisms, which differ due to different evaluation of the tradeoff between participation and bid-preparation costs. Thus, the auctioneer needs to decide on an objective. However, reducing bid-preparation costs improves the optimal values of multiple objective functions.
abstract_zh: 内生配给拍卖被引入以刺激竞争。此类（采购）拍卖在竞争不足时会减少招标数量。本文发现，当投标准备成本较高时，内生配给对参与率产生显著的负向效应，这与刺激竞争的目标相悖。针对指令中提及的多种拍卖方目标，我们推导出最优机制，这些机制因对参与率与投标准备成本之间权衡的不同评估而存在差异。因此，拍卖方需要确定一个目标。然而，降低投标准备成本能够改善多个目标函数的最优值。
title: A small volume reduction that melts down the market: Auctions with endogenous rationing
title_zh: 小规模减量引发市场崩盘：内生配给的拍卖

abstract: Measuring the local economic effects of Ukrainian long-range strikes on Russian oil refineries is difficult because reliable local data are scarce and both information and statistics are tightly controlled. This column uses nighttime lights as a proxy for economic activity to show that strikes on fixed industrial assets can generate economically meaningful and persistent local losses. They also illustrate how these losses can be measured when conventional data are unavailable, delayed, or difficult to verify independently.
abstract_zh: 衡量乌克兰远程打击俄罗斯炼油厂对当地经济的影响十分困难，因为可靠的当地数据稀缺，且信息与统计均受到严格管控。本专栏以夜间灯光作为经济活动的代理指标，表明对固定工业资产的打击能够造成具有经济意义且持续性的当地损失。同时，这些发现也展示了在传统数据不可获取、存在滞后或难以独立验证的情况下，如何衡量此类损失。
china_relevance_reason: 工作论文摘要包含中国研究常见主题词，需要 AI 确认
title: After the fire: How Ukrainian strikes disrupt local economies around Russian refineries
title_zh: 火灾之后：乌克兰袭击如何扰乱俄罗斯炼油厂周边的地方经济

abstract: This systematic review examines English-language publications documenting primary-level community programming for preventing and countering violent extremism (P/CVE) undertaken by development civil society and non-government organisations (CSO/NGOs). The objective is to identify and critically analyse the strengths, problems, gaps, and opportunities in incorporating P/CVE into international and community development work. This focus is necessary because primary-level interventions target broad community resilience, unlike secondary and tertiary interventions, which focus on at-risk or radicalised individuals. Given that development CSOs working on P/CVE programs operate independently from government-led counterterrorism efforts, this review provides insights specific to non-securitised, community-level, development-driven approaches. Source inclusion parameters were set to require empirical studies on primary-level P/CVE programs run by development CSOs. Studies of secondary and tertiary interventions, government-led programs, and initiatives by educational or religious institutions were excluded to maintain the focus on non-state, community-level, development-driven approaches. There was no restriction on location, publication date, or publication type, with both peer-reviewed and grey-literature publications included. As the P/CVE field is relatively new, it was expected that the search would mostly find publications from the 2010s and 2020s, which proved to be the case, with the earliest publication being from 2008. Records were identified using Google Scholar, Google, JSTOR Security Studies, 3ie, ALNAP, OECD iLibrary, and institutional websites, with a final search occurring on 31 January 2024. Bias was assessed by recording authors’ affiliation with the evaluand (although internal evaluations were not excluded on that basis). Extracted data was analysed using grounded theory to inductively determine themes. The systematic review incorporates 129 studies reported in 137 papers: 64% qualitative, 32% mixed-methods, and 4% quantitative. Of these, 53% were industry and evaluation reports, 31% articles, 10% books/chapters, and 6% theses. Limitations include the heterogeneity of included studies and limited evaluation rigour, which constrain reliable conclusions of program effectiveness in many papers. Grounded analysis identified three overarching thematic groupings: interconnections, power and relations, and impact. Common findings across papers highlighted the opportunities for P/CVE programming to enhance the work already being conducted by development CSOs, although papers cautioned that this needs to be carefully designed, implemented, and assessed with consideration of context, objectives, appropriate terminology, local agency, sustainability, marginalised groups, and potential for perverse outcomes. The need for consistent, long-term, untied funding of development CSOs’ P/CVE programs was frequently raised, as was the importance of prioritising local participation in all aspects of programming. Many papers noted the value of effective coordination and collaboration horizontally between communities and CSOs as well as vertically between global and local authorities and academia. Evidence of effectiveness was heterogeneous, with some studies measuring impact and others measuring satisfaction. This likely underlies a particular problem with monitoring and evaluation in this nascent field rather than necessarily representing problematic programming. Key issues with monitoring and evaluation typically include unclear and infeasible theories of change, poor monitoring practices, and limited ability to conduct rigorous evaluation due to insufficient funding and capacity. The most promising practices centred on the evaluation of changes in knowledge, attitudes, social cohesion, and wellbeing. Rather than trying to evaluate the impact of a development program on a reduction in violent extremism, these evaluations demonstrated how P/CVE programs influenced the conditions that facilitate violent extremism and sought to enhance presumed protective factors. While the mechanisms that link these outcomes to P/CVE certainly require further investigation, there is evidence emerging that these preventative programs can strengthen individual and community resilience.
abstract_zh: 本系统综述梳理了以英文发表的、由发展型民间社会组织与非政府组织（CSO/NGO）实施的、旨在预防和应对暴力极端主义（P/CVE）的初级社区项目文献。研究目标在于识别并批判性分析将P/CVE纳入国际与社区发展工作的优势、问题、空白与机遇。之所以聚焦初级干预，是因为其针对的是广泛的社区韧性，而二级和三级干预则聚焦于高风险或已激进化个体。鉴于从事P/CVE项目的发展型CSO独立于政府主导的反恐行动，本综述提供了针对非安全化、社区层面、发展驱动型方法的独特见解。文献纳入标准要求必须包含发展型CSO实施的初级P/CVE项目的实证研究。为保持对非国家、社区层面、发展驱动型方法的聚焦，排除了二级和三级干预、政府主导项目以及教育或宗教机构倡议的研究。研究未对地点、发表年份或发表类型设限，同行评审文献与灰色文献均纳入分析。由于P/CVE领域相对新兴，预期搜索结果主要来自2010年代和2020年代——事实确如此，最早文献发表于2008年。通过Google Scholar、Google、JSTOR Security Studies、3ie、ALNAP、OECD iLibrary及机构网站检索记录，最终检索日期为2024年1月31日。通过记录作者与被评估对象的隶属关系评估偏倚（但内部评估未因此被排除）。采用扎根理论对提取数据进行归纳性主题分析。本系统综述纳入129项研究（报告于137篇论文中）：64%为定性研究，32%为混合方法研究，4%为定量研究。其中53%为行业与评估报告，31%为期刊文章，10%为书籍/章节，6%为学位论文。局限性包括纳入研究的异质性及评估严谨性不足，这导致许多论文中关于项目有效性的可靠结论受限。扎根分析识别出三大主题群：相互关联性、权力与关系、影响。论文中的共同发现凸显了P/CVE项目增强发展型CSO现有工作的机遇，但论文也警示需结合情境、目标、恰当术语、地方能动性、可持续性、边缘群体及潜在负面后果进行审慎设计、实施与评估。发展型CSO的P/CVE项目需要持续、长期、无附加条件的资金支持这一诉求被频繁提及，同时强调在项目各环节优先保障地方参与的重要性。许多论文指出，社区与CSO之间的横向协调合作，以及全球与地方当局及学术界之间的纵向协作具有重要价值。有效性证据呈现异质性：部分研究测量影响，部分则测量满意度。这很可能反映了这一新兴领域监测评估中的特定问题，而非必然代表项目设计缺陷。监测评估的关键问题通常包括：变革理论不清晰且不可行、监测实践薄弱、因资金与能力不足导致严格评估受限。最具前景的实践聚焦于知识、态度、社会凝聚力与福祉变化的评估。这些评估并非试图衡量发展项目对减少暴力极端主义的影响，而是展示P/CVE项目如何影响助长暴力极端主义的条件，并致力于增强假定的保护性因素。尽管将这些结果与P/CVE关联的机制仍需进一步探究，但已有证据表明，这些预防性项目能够增强个体与社区的韧性。
title: Development approaches for preventing violent extremism: A systematic review of the empirical evidence
title_zh: 预防暴力极端主义的发展路径：实证证据的系统综述
